notes: scan047.N1. The page identifies X_{Delta_1} as the graph of an order on S=X_{Delta_0}={(x,i) in X times I: x in X_i}, describes the resulting category object, and gives composition as the endpoint projection from composable pairs. The final sentence is unfinished after en and is preserved without completion.

scan047.N2. Targeted check of (8): assuming the written order on I is a partial order, (x,i)<=(y,j) iff x=y and i<=j is reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive on S. Reflexivity uses i<=i. Opposite inequalities force i=j and x=y, hence equality of pairs. Two successive relations give equal X-coordinates and i<=j<=k, hence the composite relation. The phrase ordre discret on X means the equality order; it does not assert that the topology of X is discrete.

scan047.N3. Targeted check of the composition description: writing a relation-arrow as (u,v), the fibre product for target b and source sigma consists of pairs ((u,v),(v,w)). Its identification with triples (u,v,w) is exactly the left lower triple-product placement in (9). Transitivity gives u<=w, so projection to (u,w) lands in X_{Delta_1}. For a chain u<=v<=w<=t, either association yields (u,t); the diagonal pairs supply identities. This verifies the local algebraic construction without deciding a letter from its expected meaning.

scan047.N4. The topological category assertion is compatible with the displayed inclusions. If S and R=X_{Delta_1} have their intended subspace topologies, the source/target, diagonal and endpoint projection are restrictions of continuous product maps; the composable-pair space is the usual pullback subspace. The packet does not contain the earlier definition (6) or all topology choices, so those choices are carried as background rather than independently reconstructed or asserted proved.

scan047.N5. Visual state checks: the apparent cancelled fragment after étant is the compressed -ant ending with a crossed final t. The overtraced X in line 12 has residual loops but no separately established deletion. No other insertion, deletion or marginal prose is present. The two quotation marks at each end are double strokes. Diagram (9) has one top horizontal arrow, two standalone cap-shaped vertical relations, and no bottom horizontal arrow.

scan047.N6. The authorial page number 11 and pale foliation 46 are separate physical elements and separate H omissions. The foliation is recorded with margin; this wrapper change does not change C’s digits. The manuscript hyphen in com-/me is retained, while H’s joined comme has the same lexical reading.

scan047.N7. Source-letter adjudication: after local inspection left both a and sigma shape-compatible, the root supplied an updated notation conclusion from the current run: the source projection of (6) is sigma, supported by an unambiguous sigma in (7a) and explicit connecting prose. Both scan047 forms lack a clear a-only stem and admit that sigma. The final text therefore uses sigma at medium in both physical places. This reader did not inspect any other page; the supporting cross-page evidence is supplied notation evidence. The two occurrences are separate C changes.

scan047.N8. Definition annotation: the written form is unaccented def, without a final stop, above the equality sign. One comparison row records this single physical annotation including spelling and placement. Formula tag (9) is left of the diagram; its typeset alignment follows the edition’s left-number convention.

scan047.N9. Blind adjudication reopens two compressed function words. The first now favors et with de as alternative, from its similarity to the clearly written et beside sigma and b; the syntactically smoother de is not imposed. Dans/des remains open in the next phrase. The final X is secure, but its looped pen history is not promoted into a definite deleted U. The full diagram and both sigma selections stand.
